ak820 setup

 ✗ Keyboard found
     Plug the keyboard in with the USB-C cable and slide the switch on the back to USB. Bluetooth and the 2.4G dongle cannot control the screen.
 ✗ Permission rule installed
     Run this once, then unplug and replug the keyboard:
         ak820 setup --print-rule | sudo tee /etc/udev/rules.d/70-ak820.rules >/dev/null && sudo udevadm control --reload && sudo udevadm trigger

Fix the items marked ✗, then run `ak820 setup` again.
